verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth documents its own token export files, and the backup docs say encryption is optional, which implies an unencrypted export is possible. The evidence never describes the file format as open or readable, and never shows another authenticator importing it, so the no-lock-in exit path is only implied. The import list covers migrating into 2FAS, not out of it. Missing for 10: documentation of the export format's structure or openness, a confirmed plaintext export option, evidence that other apps can import 2FAS exports, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full TOTP export.

support.subject: As a power user, I can export all my TOTP secrets in an open, readable format and leave for another app whenever I choose — no lock-in
